future_check: Keep a focused canonical disconnected-mask regression whenever self_check or mask construction changes.
rationale: Canonical train[1] has a disconnected right mask. Requiring connectedness rejected an authoritative input and would bias the curriculum away from the actual coordinate-intersection rule.
summary: Panel masks are arbitrary monochrome sets; 4-connectivity is not a task invariant.

future_check: After schedule edits, rerun the 12-lesson semantic gate and require all five named competitors to have zero survivors.

summary: Every five consecutive sample indexes include two canonical anchors and warm, cool, and varied examples with overlap sizes 1 through 5.

future_check: Preserve this negative recombination fixture and add equivalent discarded-feature probes to shared tooling where task hooks make them possible.

future_check: Have the independent monitor decide whether a low-rate multicolor-left lawful branch would improve generality without weakening the binary-mask cue.
rationale: All canonical left masks are monochrome, and varying the mask color across examples is sufficient to teach color-agnostic nonzero masking while preserving the canonical visual cue. Within-panel multicolor left masks are valid under the oracle but remain outside this teaching grammar.
summary: Generated left panels remain monochrome even though the oracle only tests nonzero versus zero.

future_check: Treat any new schedule profile as unsafe until every named rival is refuted in every sliding lesson window.
rationale: Each shortcut agrees with some sparse examples, so normal draws deliberately include left-only/right-only controls, holes, margins, and distinct colours. The semantic gate verifies every claimed discriminator against the canonical output.
summary: Copy-panel, union, no-crop, bbox-fill, and wrong-colour rules are plausible but false shortcuts.

future_check: Run the current override v6 matrix after any AXES edit and require ordinary keyed draws to round-trip through observe_overrides.
rationale: The former overlap_k and density controls were accepted but unconsumed or unobservable. Exact dimensions cover the useful boundary surface without metadata that lies about what was generated.

summary: The hypothesis that the right panel must be one 4-connected object is false.
